info.title: Andaru local engine API
info.description: Experimental root-local engine API over Unix sockets only. Verified UID 0 SO_PEERCRED authorizes every route. Network status is observed; configuration writes create durable saved versions and never activate networking. An apply activates the saved head's network area as a live generation behind a rollback timer and needs explicit confirmation. No application accounts, HTTP identity headers, cookie/token authentication or backup service is implemented. Contracts remain provisional until Andaru 1.0.

get.summary: Read the complete current host link/address snapshot
get.description: Reads Debian iproute2 in the engine's host namespace. Failure is explicit, never a partial snapshot or a stale cache. Addresses retain host bits. The bounded full snapshot is not paginated.

ifIndex.description: Observed kernel index; not persistent identity

operState.description: Observed tool state, including UNKNOWN where reported

linkAddress.description: Current link-layer address if supplied, not a permanent MAC promise

address.description: Host IP address, not a network-masked prefix

details.description: Safe field errors with request-relative JSON Pointers; empty for non-field failures.

findings.description: Why an apply was refused (APPLY_REFUSED only).

version.description: The list's version after this save; the next If-Match is "order.<version>".

order.description: The rule IDs in the order this request saved.

interface.description: Kernel interface currently carrying that permanent MAC

path.description: Destination a later apply would write

secret.description: True when the real file holds a secret; content then shows <redacted> in its place

sources.description: JSON Pointers into the saved snapshot value

path.description: JSON Pointer into the saved snapshot value; empty for host-wide findings

state.description: Never saved, applied or live state

realizable.description: True when no finding is an error

savedVersion.description: Must be the saved head: the version the operator previewed.

takeover.description: Replace netplan and cloud-init as the host's network configuration. Required exactly when netplan still configures the host.

confirmTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds until the change is rolled back unless confirmed.

state.description: awaiting_confirmation is live but will be rolled back at the deadline; only confirmed survives a reboot.

previous.description: What was live before this apply; null is the pre-Andaru baseline.

reason.description: Why the apply failed or was rolled back, or what remains to finish at the next boot; empty otherwise.

files.description: Files of this generation; their content is shown by the preview.

lastKnownGood.description: The generation confirmed before it; boot falls back to it.

pending.description: The apply awaiting confirmation, if any.

live.description: What runs now; null is the pre-Andaru baseline. Differs from confirmed after a boot fallback.

path.description: What the finding is about: a JSON Pointer into the saved snapshot value, an interface name, a systemd unit name or a host file path; empty for host-wide findings.

ChangeOperation.description: One operation of a change batch, as POST /api/v1/config/changes accepts it.

operations.description: A create-only change batch describing what the host does now; send it to the draft preview and then to /api/v1/config/changes.

starter.description: The LAN's starter services and rules and outbound NAT, whether or not the detection put them in operations; a client that changes an adapter's zone adds the ones operations left out.

dhcp.description: A DHCP server offered per static LAN segment. Never part of operations, so taking over without questions serves no DHCP; a client that accepts an offer adds it to the batch.

addressed.description: The adapter has a global address now; leaving it out would cut it off.

required.description: ifupdown configures the adapter, and the takeover masks ifupdown for every interface, so it cannot be left out.

findings.description: Why the host cannot be taken over as it stands.

state.description: Rendered from a batch that was not saved.

realizable.description: True when no finding is an error

applyFindings.description: What the apply gates would refuse, judged as a takeover unless one is already confirmed.

rules.description: The policy in execution order, references by name, for the review.

Forbidden.description: Missing, unverified or non-root Unix peer; JSON error for GET, no body for HEAD

InventoryUnavailable.description: Command, parsing, size or deadline failure; never a partial success
